newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks continue upward trend in London.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks continue upward trend in London.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks rose slightly on Tuesday in light trading, tracking the UK's FTSE 100 index despite earlier losses in Hong Kong.

The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 20.37 points at 12,127.13 by 1405 GMT. The Hang Seng had closed down 26.31 points at 12,106.76 in Hong Kong, pausing for breath after rising 227.56 points on Monday.
"The Hong Kong market is pretty positive, with money coming in from other Asian markets," one trader said.
HSBC Holdings again provided the only point of interest in an otherwise dull market, traders said. The bank's shares rose to HK$147.03 in London after closing at HK$146.0 in Hong Kong.

The UK's FTSE 100 index fell as low 3,995.3 on Tuesday after an announcement from the UK Treasury that it was scrapping tax credits on share buybacks. Shares later recovered and the leading index was up 2.2 points at at 4,033.7 by 1412 GMT.
